description: As a remote sensing technician setting up an operational monitoring pipeline for a national land survey agency, create and execute a fully automated multi-step processing chain using SNAP's Graph Processing Tool (GPT). The chain must process both Sentinel-2 spectral band files (sentinel2_B04_red.tif and sentinel2_B08_nir.tif located in /home/ga/snap_data/) through the following sequence: read both input files, collocate them into a single co-registered product, compute a vegetation index from the combined bands using BandMaths, apply a spatial subset to reduce the output extent, and write the final product. The entire workflow must be defined in a single GPT-compatible XML graph file containing at least five connected operator nodes (Read, Read, Collocate, BandMaths, Subset, Write). Execute the graph using /opt/snap/bin/gpt and verify the output product is created at /home/ga/snap_projects/. Save the graph XML file so another operator could reproduce the processing independently.
